parts.name: Pressing Lid
parts.Basic_description: The pressing lid is the top part of the dispenser, made of polypropylene plastic, designed to be pressed by hand.
parts.Functional_description: It acts as the actuator that dispenses liquid when pressed, controlling the flow of soap or shampoo.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically downward when pressed and returns upward via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Head (Other)
parts.Basic_description: The head connects the pressing lid to the pump mechanism, made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It transfers the pressing force from the lid to the internal pump, enabling liquid to be drawn up and dispensed.
parts.Movement_description: It moves slightly with the lid during pressing, transmitting motion to the internal pump shaft.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the dispenser, made of HDPE plastic, cylindrical in shape.
parts.Functional_description: It stores the liquid product such as soap, shampoo, or lotion, and provides structural support for the pump assembly.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, serving as the stable reservoir for the liquid.
